currentUserGoal: Add haptic vibration feedback for mobile play, keep it optional in Options, and make sure the mobile hot path stays performant.
changesMade: Added a small HapticsSystem wrapper around navigator.vibrate with support checks, visibility checks, cue-specific patterns, and cooldowns.
Added persisted haptics settings using grassTouching.hapticsEnabled, defaulting to enabled.
Added an in-game Options toggle that shows Haptics: On/Off when supported and Haptics: N/A when the browser does not expose vibration support.

Added haptic cues for grass touches, first touch, crits, perfect touches, regrowing/blocked taps, hazard interactions, world-object placement, skill upgrade success/failure, and milestone celebrations.
Kept haptics out of perf/hazard harness touches by passing the harness source through hazard handling.
Adjusted the in-game Options layout on narrow mobile widths so the new haptics button and track selector fit cleanly.
verification: Browser visual smoke at 390x844: Options panel displays Music, SFX, Haptics, Track, and Back controls without overlap.

Browser perf harness at 390x844, ?perfHarness&tiles=1200: status complete, visibleTiles stayed viewport-capped at 121-143, layoutPasses 0, redraws 0, redrawQueued 0, maxFrameDeltaMs 12ms or lower, frameSpikes 0, displayObjects 845-860 after overlays settled, activeTweens 13-21, hotspots stayed in normal frame/update/UI ranges.
currentGitStatus: Expected modified files before commit: src/game/scenes/GameScene.ts plus new haptics settings/system files and handoff updates.

Unrelated untracked docs/assets remain untouched: docs/GAME_SYSTEMS_REFERENCE CLAUDE.md, Dutch automation docs, docs/artifacts/title-art-2026-06-19/, docs/grasstouching.mid, docs/lucid.aif, handoffs/HANDOFF_2026-06-20_POST_PUSH_WORKFLOW_TEST.json.
knownIssues: Actual vibration depends on browser support for navigator.vibrate. Unsupported browsers will show Haptics: N/A and no-op safely.
Desktop browser testing cannot physically verify phone vibration hardware.
nextRecommendedSteps: Deploy production and have the user hard refresh on a phone.
On Android Chrome or another browser with Vibration API support, confirm normal grass taps feel subtle while crit/perfect/milestone cues are distinct.
On iOS Safari, confirm the game remains stable and the Options menu clearly reports haptics availability if the browser does not expose vibration support.
doNotRevert: Do not remove the support check around navigator.vibrate; unsupported mobile browsers must no-op safely.
Do not trigger haptics from perf or hazard harness paths.
Do not remove cue cooldowns; persistent touch should never spam the vibration motor.
